meanings.meaning: 逃学者，旷课者（指逃学或旷课的学生） verb. 逃学，旷课
meanings.usage: 作为动词表示逃学的行为
形容人缺乏创意或想象力
通过免费搭乘过路车辆旅行
用于描述同时发生的两件事
指无声无息地移动，通常为不引起注意
指两个国家或地区之间的分界线

meanings.meaning: 羞耻，羞愧（感到尴尬或失去尊严的感觉） verb. 使羞耻，使蒙羞
meanings.usage: put to shame为固定搭配，意为使相形见绌

phrases.usage: 指学生逃学、旷课的行为

examples.en: Children who play truant from school are unimaginative.
examples.zh: 逃学的孩子都缺乏想象力。

examples.en: He was caught when playing truant.

phrases.usage: 使...相形见绌，使...自愧不如

examples.en: They have all been put to shame by this boy.
examples.zh: 他们都被这个男孩比得黯然失色。

examples.en: He fell asleep and the boat travelled to Calais in the meantime.
examples.zh: 他睡着了，船在这期间航行到了加来。

examples.en: The driver left him just outside the city.
examples.zh: 司机把他留在城外不远处。

examples.en: There he was picked up by a policeman.
examples.zh: 在那里他被警察带走了。

examples.en: He has surely set up a record for truant children.
examples.zh: 他无疑为逃学的孩子们创下了一项纪录。

examples.en: Children who dream of evading school.

phrases.usage: 他们最多也就...，他们的极限是...

examples.en: Eight hours in a cinema is usually as far as they get.
examples.zh: 在电影院待八个小时通常是他们能做到的极限。

examples.en: Seeing the same film over and over again.
examples.zh: 一遍又一遍地看同一部电影。

examples.en: The boat had travelled to Calais in the meantime.
examples.zh: 与此同时，船已经航行到了加来。

phrases.usage: /pɪk ʌp/ phrasal verb. 搭载，捡起（指让人上车或拾起某物）
/æz fɑːr æz/ phrase. 到...程度，就...而言（用于表示范围或程度）
/ˈoʊvər ænd ˈoʊvər əˈɡen/ phrase. 一次又一次，反复地（表示重复的动作）
/set ʌp/ phrasal verb. 建立，创建（指创立或设立某事物）

grammar.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻之前已经完成的动作，强调'过去的过去' 用于描述发生在另一个过去动作之前的动作，常与when, after, before, by等连用

examples.en: He discovered that the boat had travelled to Calais.
examples.zh: 他发现船已经航行到加来了。

examples.en: The driver gave him biscuits that he had never seen before.
examples.zh: 司机给了他一些他从未见过的饼干。

grammar.title: 过去进行时 (Past Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻正在进行的动作 用于描述过去某个时刻正在发生的事情，或表示背景动作

examples.en: While playing truant, he travelled 1,600 miles.
examples.zh: 在逃学期间，他旅行了1600英里。

examples.en: He was sleeping when the boat arrived in Calais.
examples.zh: 船到达加来时他正在睡觉。

grammar.title: 被动语态 (Passive Voice)
grammar.structure: 主语 + be动词 + 过去分词 (+ by + 动作执行者)
grammar.definition: 强调动作的承受者而非执行者，句子结构为be + 过去分词 当不知道动作执行者或强调动作承受者时使用

examples.en: He was picked up by a policeman.
He was sent back to England by the local authorities.
examples.zh: 他被当地当局送回了英国。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + have/has + been + 动词-ing + 时间段

original.en: They have all been put to shame by a boy who, while playing truant, travelled 1,600 miles.
original.zh: 他们都为一个逃学旅行了1600英里的男孩感到羞耻。

imitations.en: She has been working here for five years.
imitations.zh: 她已经在这里工作五年了。

imitations.en: He has been learning English since 2020.
imitations.zh: 他自2020年以来一直在学英语。

patterns.pattern: When/While + 主语 + 过去式， 主语 + 过去完成时

original.en: When he woke up next morning, he discovered that the boat had travelled to Calais.
original.zh: 当他第二天早上醒来时，他发现船已经航行到加来了。

imitations.en: When she arrived, I had finished my homework.
imitations.zh: 当她到达时，我已经完成了作业。

imitations.en: While he was sleeping, the thief had taken his wallet.
imitations.zh: 当他睡觉时，小偷偷走了他的钱包。

patterns.pattern: There + be + 主语 + 过去分词短语

original.en: There he was picked up by a policeman and sent back to England.
original.zh: 在那里他被警察带走并送回了英国。

imitations.en: There he was caught by his teacher.
imitations.zh: 在那里他被老师抓住了。

imitations.en: There she was welcomed by her friends.
imitations.zh: 在那里她受到了朋友们的欢迎。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + be + 形容词 + 不定式

original.en: Children who play truant from school are unimaginative.
original.zh: 逃学的孩子都缺乏想象力。

imitations.en: It is important to learn English.
He is lucky to get such a good job.
imitations.zh: 他能得到这么好的工作真是幸运。

lines.en: Children who play truant from school are unimaginative.
lines.zh: 逃学的孩子们都缺乏想像力。

lines.en: A quiet day's fishing, or eight hours in a cinema seeing the same film over and over again, is usually as far as they get.
lines.zh: 他们通常能够做到的，至多也就是安静地钓上一天鱼，或在电影院里坐上8个小时，一遍遍地看同一部电影。

lines.en: They have all been put to shame by a boy who, while playing truant, travelled 1,600 miles.
lines.zh: 而有那么一个小男孩，他在逃学期间旅行了1,600英里，从而使上述所有逃学的孩子们都相形见绌了。

lines.en: He hitchhiked to Dover and, towards evening, went into a boat to find somewhere to sleep.
lines.zh: 他搭便车到了丹佛，天快黑时钻进了一条船，想找个地方睡觉。

lines.en: When he woke up next morning, he discovered that the boat had, in the meantime , travelled to Calais.
lines.zh: 第二天早上他醒来时，发现船在这段时间已经到了加。

lines.en: No one noticed the boy as he crept off.
lines.zh: 当男孩从船里爬出来时，谁也没有发现他。

lines.en: From there, he hitchhiked to Paris in a lorry.
lines.zh: 从那里他又搭上卡车到了巴黎。

lines.en: The driver gave him a few biscuits and a cup of coffee and left him just outside the city.
lines.zh: 司机给了他几块饼干和一杯咖啡，就把他丢在了城外。

lines.en: The next car the boy stopped did not take him into the centre of Paris as he hoped it would, but to Perpignan on the French-Spanish border.
lines.zh: 男孩截住的下一辆车，没有像他希望的那样把他带到巴黎市中心，而是把他带到了法国和西班牙边界上的佩皮尼昂。

lines.en: There he was picked up by a policeman and sent back to England by the local authorities .
lines.zh: 他在那儿被一个警察抓住了，之后被当局送回了英国。

lines.en: He has surely set up a record for the thousands of children who dream of evading school.
lines.zh: 他无疑为成千上万梦想逃避上学的孩子们创造了一项纪录。

questions.q: Did the boy go where he wanted to?
questions.zh: 男孩去了他想去的地方吗？
questions.a: No, he didn't. The next car did not take him into the centre of Paris as he hoped it would, but to Perpignan on the French-Spanish border, where a policeman picked him up and the local authorities sent him back to England.
questions.aZh: 没有。他本来想去巴黎市中心，却被带到了法西边境的佩皮尼昂；他在那里被警察抓住，由当地当局送回了英国。

questions.q: 作者为什么说逃学的孩子 unimaginative？他们通常的“极限”是什么？
questions.zh: 为什么说逃学的孩子缺乏想象力？
questions.a: Because a quiet day's fishing, or eight hours in a cinema seeing the same film over and over again, is usually as far as they get — truants never go beyond that.
questions.aZh: 因为他们最了不起的“壮举”也不过是安静地钓一天鱼，或在电影院里把同一部影片反复看上八小时。

questions.q: How did the boy cross the Channel without knowing it?
questions.zh: 男孩如何在不知情的情况下渡过英吉利海峡？
questions.a: He hitchhiked to Dover and, towards evening, went into a boat to find somewhere to sleep. When he woke up next morning, the boat had, in the meantime, travelled to Calais, and no one noticed him as he crept off.
questions.aZh: 他搭便车到了多佛，天快黑时钻进一条船里找地方睡觉；早上醒来时船已开到加来，他爬下船时谁也没有发现他。
questions.hint: 见第 4-6 句，注意 in the meantime 与 crept off。

questions.q: How did the lorry driver treat him, and why was he finally sent back to England?
questions.zh: 卡车司机怎样对待他？他为何最终被送回英国？
questions.a: The driver gave him a few biscuits and a cup of coffee and left him just outside the city; the next car took him to Perpignan, where a policeman picked him up and the local authorities sent him back to England.
questions.aZh: 司机给了他几块饼干和一杯咖啡，把他留在城外；下一辆车把他带到佩皮尼昂，他在那里被警察抓住并遣送回英国。
questions.hint: 见第 8-10 句，pick up 此处意为“逮捕”。

questions.q: Was the boy really more imaginative than other truants? Why does the writer call him a record-holder?
questions.zh: 他真的比其他逃学者更有想象力吗？为什么称他为纪录保持者？
questions.a: Hardly by design: he only wanted somewhere to sleep and was carried abroad by chance. The writer calls him a record-holder humorously — by accident he travelled much further than any unimaginative truant, putting them all to shame.
questions.aZh: 很难说是刻意为之：他只是想找个地方睡觉，却阴差阳错被船带出了国。作者幽默地称他为纪录保持者——他无意中走得比任何逃学者都远。
questions.hint: 结合标题、unimaginative、put to shame 与 set up a record。

translation:
逃学的孩子们都缺乏想像力。
他们通常能够做到的，至多也就是安静地钓上一天鱼，或在电影院里坐上8个小时，一遍遍地看同一部电影。
而有那么一个小男孩，他在逃学期间旅行了1,600英里，从而使上述所有逃学的孩子们都相形见绌了。
他搭便车到了丹佛，天快黑时钻进了一条船，想找个地方睡觉。
第二天早上他醒来时，发现船在这段时间已经到了加。
当男孩从船里爬出来时，谁也没有发现他。
从那里他又搭上卡车到了巴黎。
司机给了他几块饼干和一杯咖啡，就把他丢在了城外。
男孩截住的下一辆车，没有像他希望的那样把他带到巴黎市中心，而是把他带到了法国和西班牙边界上的佩皮尼昂。
他在那儿被一个警察抓住了，之后被当局送回了英国。
他无疑为成千上万梦想逃避上学的孩子们创造了一项纪录。
title: The record-holder
subtitle: 纪录保持者

lead.question: 逃学的孩子大多缺乏想象力，可这个男孩为何反倒成了纪录保持者？
lead.warmup: 同样是逃学，多数孩子至多安静钓一天鱼，或在电影院里把同一部影片看上八小时。可本课的小主人公一路搭便车，钻进船里睡了一觉，醒来时竟已漂到加来；又坐卡车到了巴黎，被下一辆车带到法西边境的佩皮尼昂。逃学逃出国境，结局却不浪漫——他被警察抓住，遣送回英国。
goals: 复述男孩从多佛经加来、巴黎到佩皮尼昂的逃学路线与最终结局
掌握 play truant、put ... to shame、in the meantime、as far as、creep off、evade 等核心表达
辨析 who、while、when、as 引导的从句以及 and、but 构成的并列句
仿写现在分词作状语的句子，如 while playing truant
lead.summary: 本课记述一个逃学男孩无意中旅行一千六百英里的经历：搭便车到多佛，钻进船里过夜，醒来发现船已开到加来，趁无人注意爬下船，又搭卡车到巴黎，最后被带到法西边境的佩皮尼昂，被警察截获后遣送回英国。
lead.tips: put ... to shame（使……相形见绌）不等于 be ashamed of（为……感到羞耻）。

exercises.q: 词汇填空：Many children dream of ______ (evade) school, and some of them even play ______ from it every week.
exercises.note: dream of 后接动名词；play truant 逃学。

exercises.q: 用现在分词短语改写：While he was playing truant, the boy travelled 1,600 miles.
exercises.a: While playing truant, the boy travelled 1,600 miles.
exercises.note: 主从句主语一致可省略。

exercises.q: 写出 unimaginative 的反义词，并用它翻译：画家应当富于想像力。
用 put ... to shame 改写：His 1,600-mile journey made all other truants look ordinary.
exercises.a: His 1,600-mile journey put all other truants to shame.
exercises.note: put ... to shame 使……相形见绌。

exercises.q: 同义替换：When he woke up next morning, he discovered that the boat had, in the meantime, travelled to Calais.
exercises.a: Meanwhile, the boat had travelled to Calais.

exercises.q: 连词填空：The next car the boy stopped did not take him into the centre of Paris ______ he hoped it would, ______ to Perpignan.
exercises.note: as 引导方式状语从句，but 连接并列状语。

exercises.q: 中译英：第二天早上他醒来时发现船已经到了加来，他趁没人注意爬下船，又搭上一辆卡车去了巴黎。
exercises.a: When he woke up next morning, he discovered that the boat had travelled to Calais. No one noticed him as he crept off, and he hitchhiked to Paris in a lorry.
exercises.note: creep off 爬离；hitchhike 搭便车。

quiz.q: 标题中的 “the record-holder” 指的是谁？
options: The boy who travelled 1,600 miles while playing truant
The lorry driver who gave him biscuits and coffee
The policeman who picked him up
The child who watched the same film eight hours
quiz.note: 指逃学旅行 1,600 英里的男孩。

quiz.q: “Children who play truant from school are unimaginative.” 中 play truant 的意思是：
options: Stay away from school without permission
Play games in the playground
Travel abroad during the holidays
Sit quietly fishing for a whole day

quiz.q: 课文中 “that is usually as far as they get” 里的 as far as 表示：
options: To the greatest degree they can ever reach
To a place very far away
As long as the day is quiet
Until the same film is over

quiz.q: “The boat had, in the meantime, travelled to Calais.” 中 in the meantime 可替换为：
options: meanwhile
in the end
as far as
over and over again

quiz.q: 选择正确形式填空：No one noticed the boy as he ______ off.
options: creeped
crept
was creep
has creeping

quiz.q: 男孩最终没能进入巴黎市中心，原因是：
options: The boat took him straight back to England
The next car took him to Perpignan on the French-Spanish border
The lorry driver left him inside the city
He gave up and went back to school
